topic: Explanation of Fly by wire control systems using Fly by Wire demonstrator at Control Lab.
syllabus_extract: Explanation of Fly by wire control systems using Fly by Wire demonstrator at Control Lab.
specific_objectives: 20.4.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain principles of Aero engine control systems.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Fly by Wire demonstrator; Safety: Do not touch live circuits; Instructor supervision required during operation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a fly-by-wire system?
How does a fly-by-wire system differ from a conventional hydraulic system?
What are the key components of a fly-by-wire architecture?

topics: Definition of Fly by Wire Systems
development.content:
Definition of Fly by Wire Systems
System Architecture Overview
Sensor and Actuator Roles
Flight Control Computer Functions
Redundancy and Safety Features

Operational Principles of FBW
Signal Transmission Path
Control Law Implementation
Failure Mode Analysis
Manual Override Mechanisms

Comparison with Conventional Systems
Advantages of FBW Technology
Limitations and Constraints
Future Trends in FBW
Integration with Engine Control

summary_questions: Explain the role of the Flight Control Computer in a fly-by-wire system.
Describe how redundancy is achieved in fly-by-wire architectures.
What happens to the control system if a sensor fails?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of fly-by-wire systems relate to Full Authority Digital Engine Control (FADEC) systems discussed in LP 14.
